rationale: The plan uses DESeq2 Wald on raw counts with edgeR quasi-likelihood as a concordance check, exactly matching the design (3v3, unpaired, single batch), and explicitly forbids batch correction, imputation, or dropping samples at n=3. QC precedes testing with library sizes, detection rates, filterByExpr, VST, PCA with percent variance, and distance/correlation heatmaps, plus a stated no-removal policy for outliers. Normalization stays inside the model (DESeq2 size factors, edgeR TMM), the design formula and reference level (control) are explicit with direction stated, and multiple testing is BH at 0.05/0.1 with apeglm shrinkage, lfcThreshold testing and s-values rather than post hoc filtering or a lowered alpha. Enrichment is rank-based fgsea on the full retained list with the ranking metric named, human hallmark and GO-BP collections resolved from the reference store, redundancy collapsing, and an explicit note that the 12,000-gene matrix restricts the universe — only the collection version is unstated. Reporting covers method, design, thresholds, gene counts tested and significant by direction, and honest caveats about 4 residual df and leave-one-out being a stability probe, not validation; package versions are not explicitly promised.
